transport: Cable-connected SSH for installation/repair preflight only. No normal-use transport over SSH.
reason: The host-only integration passed. Unknown device state and an existing webserver-remote extension prevent a safe unconditional installation approval. First establish only the bounded compatibility and target-occupancy facts needed for a separate installation/activation/rollback proposal.

platform: Device model and firmware release metadata only
Existing SSH host-key verification; never accept a changed host key automatically
allowed_reads.metadata_definition: Report existence, symlink status, file type, mode, numeric owner/group and byte size only. Do not follow symlinks or read runtime/configuration contents. Hash only an explicitly listed regular, non-symlink binary/hashtab file after metadata checks. If a file is absent, record absence; do not create it.

stop_conditions: SSH host-key mismatch or unverified host identity
Unexpected firmware, stock binary hash, hashtab hash, symlink or file type
Occupied proposed-owned path; record collision and stop rather than repair
Any failure or need for broader investigation; preserve state and report without retry
excluded: Installation, uploads, helpers, remote temporary files, configuration writes, permission changes or client replacement
Xochitl/service restarts, reboots, activation changes, qmlcache changes or firmware updates
Document/library listing, opening, importing, exporting, moving, deletion or private notebook access
Credential/config contents, account/cloud settings, screenshots or capture helpers
Process scanners, process detection, process termination or cleanup0038 retries
Removal, renaming, disabling or alteration of existing webserver-remote or any other extension
separate_next_approval: After successful read-only preflight and source audit, propose exact owned paths, payload and setup trust identities, synthetic document scope, activation changes, saved/closed restart count and reversible restoration. This preflight approval does not authorize that next step.
